name: accounting-closing
description: Check a NetSuite period close checklist to see what blocks month-end close and what can happen next. Works from pasted text and exports to identify remaining tasks, scope gaps and close-state blockers.

interface.shortDescription: Check what blocks NetSuite month-end close.
interface.longDescription: Check a NetSuite period close checklist to see what blocks month-end close and what can happen next. Diagnose locked and closed states from supplied evidence.
defaultPrompt: Turn this pasted NetSuite checklist into a readiness list by accounting book and subsidiary.
Explain this locked-period message and what reopening would affect.
